title: On Askey's extension of Clausen's identity and its polynomial perturbation
summary: The celebrated Clausen's identity expresses the square of the Gauss hypergeometric series ${}_2F_{1}(a,b;a+b+1/2;x)$ as a single hypergeometric ${}_3F_2$ series. Goursat showed in 1883 that replacing $1/2$ by $m+1/2$ leads to a hypergeometric series for the square whenever $m$ is a positive integer. Askey found this series explicitly for $m=1$. The first goal of this paper is to extend this result by treating the case of any natural $m$.
